schoolName: Pontificia Universidad Catolica Madre y Maestra
reviewNotes: HOLD - PUCMM officially describes a Medicine degree lasting five years and eight months at Santiago and Santo Domingo, with pre-medical, basic medical science, clinical pre-internship and internship stages. It publishes 2026/27 admission criteria and institution-wide registration/credit charges; its current pages also describe local clinical-internship activity. However, CAAM-HP lists the PUCMM School of Medicine as Accreditation Denied. This status must not be softened or replaced with marketing claims. Hold pending an authoritative explanation of the status, programme-specific cost calculation, foreign-student pathway, and market-specific professional-eligibility review.
